hazards.control: Bleed the tubing and casing to zero and verify before breaking any connection.

name: Gear reducer
function: The double-reduction gearbox that turns the prime mover speed into a few strokes per minute at the crank shaft.

tabs.overview: Rated by peak torque in API 11E; oil bath lubrication.
tabs.safety: Oil level and leaks checked; overload from imbalance shows as gear damage.
tabs.evidence: PetroWiki sucker-rod lift, ESP, and gas lift pages (S39, S40, S41); API 11AX, 11E, 11S, 11V (S43 to S46); field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
